signal: ReCharge acquired Skio for $105M (April 2026), the largest private acquisition in subscription commerce, and now powers 20,000+ merchants and $20B+ in GMV.

email.body1:
Adam, saw ReCharge bring Skio on board in that $105M deal, now powering 20,000+ merchants.

Consolidating two books and two motions usually leaves more in-market accounts in play than the team can personally cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ReCharge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Adam, quick follow-up for ReCharge.

Post-acquisition, the question is how many meetings the team needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of the combined number, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ReCharge needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Adam, last bit of proof for ReCharge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ReCharge's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Adam, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know folding in an acquisition is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to ReCharge either way.
